payload.title: Capture Cursor agent-transcript schema from a real Mac
payload.description:
Capture and pin the agent-CLI transcript format from a real Mac: JSONL transcripts at ~/.cursor/projects/<sanitized-path>/agent-transcripts/<session-id>/<session-id>.jsonl (the project path with slashes replaced by dashes), with per-session metadata in ~/.cursor/chats/<workspace-hash>/<session-id>/store.db. The line-level schema (type, role, text, timestamp fields) is not publicly documented — pin it from real files before writing extraction. Also check whether older plain-text .txt transcripts coexist. Record findings; never commit real transcripts.

Done when: the line schema is documented from real files, synthetic fixtures encode it, and findings record the evidence.
